title: Parameters

context.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response. Options: view and edit. Default is view.
context.title: Context

page.description: Current page of the collection. Default is 1.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set. Default is 10.
per_page.title: Per Page

search.description: Limit results to those matching a string.
search.title: Search Query

after.description: Limit response to resources published after a given ISO8601 compliant date.
after.title: Published After

before.description: Limit response to resources published before a given ISO8601 compliant date.
before.title: Published Before

modified_after.description: Limit response to resources modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.
modified_after.title: Modified After

modified_before.description: Limit response to resources modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.
modified_before.title: Modified Before

dates_are_gmt.description: Whether to interpret dates as GMT when limiting response by published or modified date.
dates_are_gmt.title: Dates Are GMT

exclude.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.
exclude.title: Exclude IDs

include.description: Limit result set to specific ids.
include.title: Include IDs

offset.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.
offset.title: Offset

order.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending. Options: asc and desc. Default is desc.
order.title: Sort Order

orderby.description: Sort collection by object attribute. Options: date, modified, id, include, title and slug. Default is date.
orderby.title: Order By

code.description: Limit result set to resources with a specific code.
code.title: Coupon Code

description: Query parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating the list of coupons.
